visualCharacteristics: CSS grid image collage of 10 images, alternating 16:9 and 4:3 aspect ratios, staggered columns (masonry). Aspect ratios preserved via CSS aspect-ratio. Collage bleeds past the viewport edges on desktop. Full-viewport section with intro default content above.
contentPattern: One row per image (or one row with N image cells): image + alt. All pictures are flattened in authoring order into the collage.
